full_page.content:
1948, August 3
The following is a photocopy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey O.F.M.Cap., and a faithful transcription of it.
Bles'd be God in His Angels and in His Saints! August 3rd, 1948
God less you Grace Panyard - you and yours. Many thanks for your double favor of Aug. Ist. I hope this finds you with less pain and brighter hopes.
I've been thinking for sometime of telling you that you should spare yourself unnecessary details when convenient - as Jethro the Rev. Father-in-law of Moses told the great leader. Divide the work and share it with others. Just for Example, why write out such a detailed list every time you write? Not that they are not in- teresting or that I do not read them but because it must be more or less a drain on your time and energy, whereas they are really not necessary. Of course if you have something special its a dif- ferent story. Otherwise we pray all those inten- tions in just praying for you and your intentions in general ..... God bless you again ....
Yours in Christ Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
The original in Possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
